text:
Carmen: Quick convo to lock the benchmark story for next week's push. Need a single compact hero that conveys latency vs $/1k tokens + a micro-calculator link. Target: social + webinar landing.
Ilya: I'll pull p50/p95 and cost at seq 64/256/1024 for hosted/dedicated/private. Suggest hero use seq=256.
Rhea: Audience split: devs (speed + cost) and infra/platform (p95 and reliability). Landing should have two CTAs wired to different flows.
Dex: Hero visual idea: slab plot (horizontal bands for cost tiers) with latency scatter overlay. Minimal copy: headline + 3 bullets. I'll mock 1200x628 and 800x800 variants.
Marta: Add product callout: smart routing + graceful fallback. Show a tiny before/after p95 example to illustrate stability during spikes.
Ilya: Data note: quantized variants reduce $/1k but can affect tail latency. I'll export both raw and quantized series; use dashed lines for quantized in charts.
Carmen: Copy candidates: 1) "Latency you can rely on. Costs you can forecast." 2) "Fast responses. Predictable spend." Prefer shorter for social. Thoughts?
Rhea: #2 for ads, #1 for landing/webinar. CTAs: "Try Hosted API" and "Request Capacity Consult". Add UTM params.
Dex: Design constraints: no tiny footnotes on image. If we need legal/qualifiers, put them on the landing (downloadable CSV link).
Ilya: Deliverables: CSV + JSON for calc, plus a small table for slide copy. ETA: tomorrow AM. I'll annotate any "up to" claims.
Marta: Webinar outline: 1) framing: why latency economics matter (5m) 2) demo: routing & fallback (12m) 3) bench walkthrough (10m) 4) customer vignette (8m) 5) Q&A (5m). Keep <=40m.
Rhea: Lead routing plan: ad clicks -> landing. Use hidden field to capture company size and route enterprise leads to sales AE. A/B test headline variants for 48h.
Carmen: Micro-calc: slider for seq and tps => est $/month. Ilya provide conservative numbers and JSON so Dev can hook quickly.
Ilya: Will include cost per 1k tokens at the three seq points and assumptions in a small metadata block in the JSON.
Dex: Color palette: blue=hosted, amber=dedicated, charcoal=private. Also make a grayscale slide-safe variant.
Marta: Put a short line about SLA/backoff strategy so enterprise buyers see reliability-first messaging.
notif-bot: Calendar event created: "Bench Launch Review" tomorrow 10:00.
Carmen: Action list: @Ilya export CSV+JSON (tomorrow AM). @Dex mockups for two sizes (tomorrow noon). @Rhea landing copy + UTMs + email cadence (Wed EOD). @Marta webinar deck + FAQ (Wed EOD). I'll assemble assets and schedule review Thurs. Flag any risky claims in-thread.
Rhea: I'll set up UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_launch, utm_content=headlineA/B. Track conversions and tag enterprise leads with "bench-enterprise".
Ilya: Will add a tiny raw-data download link for transparency.
Carmen: Great. Keep the hero headline punchy and factual. Thanks team ":rocket:"
